name: Split/Second
post_apply_message:
Split/Second (2010, Black Rock Studio — Steam appid 297860, OWNED) — Apply forces GE-Proton 10.34 and, if you've supplied it, overlays the 60 FPS patch.

WHY 60 FPS MATTERS HERE: the stock PC release is capped at 30 FPS and its PHYSICS AND POWER PLAYS ARE TIED TO THE FRAME RATE — so this isn't just smoothness, the game behaves differently. The community 60 FPS patch (ducon2016, on PCGamingWiki community files) removes the limiter and corrects the physics. It works by generating a patched .exe, which is why it can't be fetched automatically.

To enable it: run the patcher on Windows against your Steam copy, then drop the resulting patched exe into the NAS local payload at
   Game Fixes/_recipes/split-second/payload/60fps/
and re-apply. The original is backed up as .gfm-orig. Off-git deliberately, like other sourced payloads. Until you add it the game still runs — just at 30 FPS.

DXVK: nothing to do. PCGW recommends DXVK for this game's frame pacing and load times, and Proton already uses DXVK, so you get that for free on the Deck.

MULTIPLAYER: the official servers were shut down; single player and split-screen are unaffected.

OWNED STEAM COPY: detection resolves via the appmanifest, so it's found wherever Steam installed it (SSD or SD) with no path prompting, and no non-Steam shortcut is created.
notes:
Built 2026-07-27 after Tony bought it on Steam (appid 297860 — verified from the live store page, and it's still sold, unlike PURE which was delisted in 2016).

Detection is by steam_appid, so install_dir_names is only a fallback and NO marker_files are declared: the exe name isn't confirmed on disk yet and a guessed marker is exactly what broke Halo MCC (lowercase mcc/ vs MCC/). Add a marker once the folder is actually present.

FIXES: the real one is the 30 FPS cap — physics and power plays are frame-rate-coupled, so the community 60 FPS patch (ducon2016, PCGW community files #1232; also distributed as 'patch 1.04') is the fix that matters. It PRODUCES a patched exe rather than shipping one, so it's a BYO copy_files payload at payload/60fps/ like 1NSANE's widescreen mod. DXVK is recommended by PCGW and comes free under Proton. Official multiplayer is dead.

Steam-owned, so: no steam_shortcut step, proton_version instead (CompatToolMapping keyed to 297860), and install_runner stays because GE builds aren't Steam-managed. UNTESTED on hardware.
